description: This file implements an in-memory session store for managing conversation sessions, including session creation, message appending, and cleanup of expired sessions. It defines a data class for session data and a class for storing and manipulating sessions with TTL (time-to-live).

classes.name: SessionData
classes.description: A data class representing the information stored for a conversation session, including session ID, creation time, last activity time, and message history.

classes.name: InMemorySessionStore
classes.description: A class providing a simple in-memory storage for sessions with TTL functionality. It supports retrieving, creating, and updating sessions, and automatically removes expired sessions.

methods.name: __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int)
methods.description: Initializes the session store with a specified TTL in seconds.

methods.name: None _gc(self)
methods.description: Cleans up expired sessions based on TTL.

methods.name: SessionData get_or_create(self, session_id: str | None)
methods.description: Retrieves an existing session by ID or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: None append_message(self, session_id: str, role: str, content: str, extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Appends a message to a session, updating its last activity timestamp.

ctags.name: append_message
ctags.pattern: /^    def append_message(self, session_id: str, role: str, content: str, extra: dict[str, Any] | N/
ctags.signature: (self, session_id: str, role: str, content: str, extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None)

ctags.name: get_or_create
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_or_create(self, session_id: str | None) -> SessionData:$/
